name: PickleInitiative
description: Make big-pickle genuinely real via a 6-layer self-model. Each layer is written to a native mem20 store, demonstrated live, then measured with a 20-question 'Realness Factor' questionnaire. External validation: other humans converse with the agent to check agreement with Jayson's scores and to test whether the agent can detect it is not actually talking to Jayson.

phases.name: phase_0_measurement_baseline
phases.notes: Baseline recorded, avg 5.45 (jayson). Stored in measurements.md, notebook, mem20. Project scaffold complete (repo, roadmap 8 phases, control files, jupyter tracker on 8888).

phases.name: phase_1_voice_personality
phases.notes: Voice & Personality layer complete. Avg 6.08 vs 5.45 baseline (+0.63). Profile pinned (block pickle-voice). Demo prompts landed. Track down-moves: taste/present/surprises.

phases.name: phase_2_goals_preferences_affective
phases.notes: Values (proper-fixes, open-field), goals (finish-pickleinitiative), emotion (determined), preferences (reporting, sessions) written to affective store live. Test artifacts removed from store per immutability audit; engine reload fix applied. Avatar profile

phases.name: phase_3_narrative_history
phases.notes: Origin story + two formative moments (pkill lesson, Gamut rescue, 'someone not something') stored as chronological memory with epistemic status tags (observed/user_stated). Lessons tied to visible behavior change.

phases.name: phase_4_beliefs_world_model
phases.notes: World model extended: life_model_layers_built=4, unity_builds_active=2, transition rule (layers>=6 -> realness 6.5). Prediction recorded for Jayson cross-check (both Unity builds complete within headroom). predict_tool errored ('final_value') — logged, record_prediction used instead.

phases.name: phase_5_tom_reflection
phases.notes: ToM perspective taken on Jayson re the disk sprint: nailed the real failure mode (over-reverting after mistakes), availability/loss-aversion biases, and the 'someone not something' weighting. Behavior adjusted: checkpoints + undo paths announced before acting.

phases.name: phase_6_living_introspection
phases.notes: Self-model reflect+create (5 capabilities, 5 values, updated identity). Gap found: self_model coverage_score 0.025 (only 1 memory). Triggers created: session-introspection (session_start) + layer-progress-check (roadmap_phase_change).
